name: Kimberly Rae Coaching: Master Closing Doc
source: Google Drive, 'KRC - Master Closing Doc' (last edited 2026-11-17). Calls before late June 2026 may predate it.
offer_includes: Group coaching calls twice a week, full education library, community. 1:1 time with Kim on paid tiers.
rules: Recommend ONE tier based on discovery, then stay silent. Do not list all tiers.
Dating outcomes can't be guaranteed. Promise the process and near-term visible change.
Do not reveal price into uncertainty. Run the temperature check first.
Do not offer payment plans to solve an uncertainty objection.

checks.text: States the call is confidential
Discloses the call is recorded
Credibility: has taken hundreds of these calls
Invites full transparency
Frames the goal of the call and gets agreement
References setter notes (or Kim's DM notes) so they feel seen
checks.conditional: only if a setter or DM preceded the call

checks.text: Opens with why they took an hour out of their day
Asks the biggest thing not working in dating/relationships
Asks what they mean, in their own words
Asks if anything else is getting in the way
Probes duration (how long, always been this way)
Probes spillover into other areas of life
Relationship status (single, seeing someone, undefined)
Apps usage
Work and meeting people organically
How long actively dating
Flexes the call to the segment (novice, achiever, rebuilder, returner)
Gets weekly mechanics (apps time, conversations, dates)
Asks where it usually falls apart
Asks what they have tried (apps, coaching, books, therapy)
Asks how that went
Asks what they think has been getting in the way
Does not correct the belief yet (saves it for the pitch)
Asks why now vs six months ago
Asks what it has been costing them, beyond dating
Goes deeper with a segment-aware cost question
Magic wand: what changes if this were solved
Lets silence breathe instead of rushing
Asks them to paint the picture a year from now
Asks why that is important to them
Asks what part they most look forward to
Asks if there is anything else they should know
Reflects their situation back and gets permission to walk through how Kim helps
High-level promise of process and visible change, no outcome guarantee
Pillar 1, The Honest Read, tied to what they've tried
Pillar 2, The Reset (profile, photos, messaging)
Pillar 3, The Inner Game
Pillar 4, Read & Lead
Delivery: group calls twice weekly, library, community, 1:1 for paid tiers
Checks for questions or understanding
Asks how they feel about the process
Uses the 1 to 10 scale when the answer is uncertain
Handles what keeps them from 9 or 10 before price
Paints getting started before revealing the investment
Recommends one tier based on discovery
Ties the recommendation to what they said
States the price and stays silent

segments.overlooked_novice: Younger man, few or no matches, shy. Pain: freezing, left on read, feeling broken.
segments.achiever: Successful woman, situationships, running out of time. Pain: passive men, the clock, fear of the DTR talk.
segments.rebuilder: Older woman, divorced, overwhelmed by apps. Pain: lost with modern dating, self-doubt, too late.
segments.returner: Older man, divorced, secure, out of practice. Pain: doesn't get the apps, no responses, fear of seeming creepy, loneliness.
segments.other: Does not fit. Propose a label in signals[0].
